title: Gift Card Claim Tenure Courtesy for Long-Standing Finch Circle Members — Merchandise Purchases
content:
On a gift card claim for a Merchandise Purchases unit, a member whose active Finch Circle membership was enrolled at least the long-tenure months of 84 months before the request date (whole months) receives the long gift card tenure courtesy of $8.00; one enrolled at least the middle-tenure months of 36 months but fewer than 84 months receives the middle gift card tenure courtesy of $4.00. A customer enrolled fewer than 36 whole months before the request date, or with no active membership, is outside this rule.

## Basis Q&A

**From what date is tenure counted?** From the enrollment date of the active membership in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program records, in whole months to the request date.

**Enrolled exactly 84 whole months before the request date?** $8.00. **83 whole months?** $4.00.

**Exactly 36 whole months?** $4.00. **35 whole months?** Outside this rule.
